follow-up time: From week 24 to week 36 of pregnancy
exposure: Vaginal community state type at week 24
finding: A novel vaginal dysbiosis score, but not bacterial vaginosis status or vaginal community state type, at week 24 was associated with an increased risk of emergency caesarean section.
mod_finding: Vaginal dysbiosis at week 24 was associated with a significantly increased risk of emergency, but not elective, caesarean section.
